# Informatica

Skills that teach agents to work with Informatica. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [forcedotcom/informatica-claude-plugins](https://github.com/forcedotcom/informatica-claude-plugins), at commit `554d02e`.

Informatica plugin for Claude Platform (Claude Code & Claude CoWork) — governed catalog discovery, data Q&A, powered by Informatica's Data catalog and Governance to understand and evaluate enterprise

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **Informatica**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **Informatica**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install informatica-for-claude-platform@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

1 skill: `catalog-and-data-discovery`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

It ships no scripts. The skills are guidance for the agent.
